subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil engineer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

Your careers page asks graduate civil engineers to email an introduction, so this is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised vacancy.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your work designing Melbourne estates with their drainage, retarding basins, wetlands and roads is the land development design I want to learn. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil engineering or civil drafting opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil engineer
paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Breese Pitt Dixon has room for a graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised vacancy, sent because your careers page invites graduates to email an introduction.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

Your four decades of Melbourne land development, designing estates with their drainage, retarding basins, wetlands and roads, is the work I want to build toward. I live in Melton VIC and hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, with full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My drafting experience is from study rather than a paid Australian design office.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my enquiry.

checklist: Confirm info@bpd.com.au is still the expression of interest address on https://www.bpd.com.au/careers.
Search Gmail for bpd.com.au and Breese Pitt Dixon in all folders; hold if any application or reply exists.
Attach the resume and this cover letter from the record's attachments.
Send the short email on this record from macdarenz@gmail.com to info@bpd.com.au.
After sending, mark the record SENT with the date and Gmail message id.
